limitations: This is a curated source atlas, not a critical edition or complete translation.
Modern coastlines are used as geographic orientation and do not reconstruct ancient shorelines.
Coordinates are approximate; several place identifications are regional or uncertain.
The browser audit used a headless Chromium render; final public deployment should also be inspected manually in Safari and Chromium.
